sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC Data Sets Available for Download (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC catalog describes Oil & Gas Field Name & Numbers records with district, field number, county code, and field name as separately named data elements.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the catalog only to support label separation and does not infer a field boundary, well or lease relationship, ownership, production, reserves, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC Oil and Gas Counties and Districts (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC page displays County, District Code, FIPS Code, and District Office in separate columns.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article preserves the page-specific FIPS label and does not silently rename it as an RRC county code or use it as a private-property key.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC Field Information manual (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC manual supplies district geography, eight-digit field-number composition, separate field-name definitions, county-code occurrences, and file-key boundaries.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article does not convert administrative geography or file relationships into field boundaries, title, ownership, production, reserves, value, or a transaction conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC Field Search (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current official Field Search surface establishes that query execution is a separate operational job.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article does not provide query inputs, execute a search, or record a result state.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC Oil Leases and Gas Wells by District and Operator (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official monthly index displays district, operator, lease, field, county, and oil-or-gas labels as separate context fields.
